notice: Prototype jurisdiction register. Scope classes are phase1 (canonical US/UK/Singapore design phase), planned (post-gate sequencing) and target (registry/catalogue domain with no activation approval). No jurisdiction is active, licensed, counsel-reviewed or permitted to transact.

regulatedActivities.activity: Alcohol retail, wholesale, fulfilment and age-at-delivery
regulatedActivities.enforcement: Deny checkout and fulfilment when jurisdiction is blocked or any control is unsatisfied.
regulatedActivities.rejection: Return a plain-language reason and record the decision in the append-only audit log.
regulatedActivities.appeal: Human review by Compliance; no automated reversal.
regulatedActivities.retention: Retain decision evidence under the approved retention schedule; no retention schedule is approved yet.

regulatedActivities.activity: Age assurance, KYC, AML and sanctions screening
regulatedActivities.enforcement: Fail closed; age/KYC providers default to local simulation and real-provider opt-ins default false.
regulatedActivities.rejection: No order or trade ability; show the reason without collecting additional sensitive data.
regulatedActivities.appeal: Named Compliance reviewer with identity evidence; no automated override.
regulatedActivities.retention: Append-only decision evidence; retention schedule pending approval.

regulatedActivities.activity: Payment capture, payouts, FX and Vault settlement
regulatedActivities.enforcement: Only simulated adapters may clear; any non-simulated provider is unknown and blocks checkout.
regulatedActivities.rejection: Block checkout and record the unknown/unlicensed adapter attempt.
regulatedActivities.appeal: Finance and Compliance review of evidence; no production override in this prototype.
regulatedActivities.retention: Financial-control records are design requirements; no approved retention schedule exists.

regulatedActivities.activity: Rare-wine investment, fractional ownership, custody and secondary trading
regulatedActivities.enforcement: Vault remains a non-live blueprint; no order, wallet, custody transfer or settlement is permitted.
regulatedActivities.rejection: Display non-performance and blocked-status notice; do not accept funds or lot instructions.
regulatedActivities.appeal: Board, Legal and Compliance review with jurisdiction-specific securities opinion.
regulatedActivities.retention: Blueprint decision records only; no investor record is created.

regulatedActivities.activity: Privacy, alcohol advertising and health-related claims
regulatedActivities.enforcement: Campaigns remain drafts until human release; blocked geographies and age groups are denied.
regulatedActivities.rejection: Reject copy with health claims or missing geography/age targeting.
regulatedActivities.appeal: Human reviewer with documented legal basis.
regulatedActivities.retention: Consent and campaign audit records are design requirements; retention schedule pending.

regulatedActivities.activity: Customs, excise, tax and consumer-protection obligations
regulatedActivities.enforcement: No shipment, tax calculation filing or dispute settlement is performed in the prototype.
regulatedActivities.rejection: Block fulfilment when tax/customs evidence is absent.
regulatedActivities.appeal: Finance/Tax and Compliance review with named evidence.
